exposure: Complete adherence of providers to antenatal care (ANC) guideline during first visit
outcome: Maternal complications during intrapartum and postpartum periods
Neonatal complications during intrapartum and postpartum periods
cohort: A total of 832 pregnant women with gestational age <28 weeks, who presented for their first ANC visit, were enrolled and followed.
finding: Complete adherence to ANC guidelines during the first visit significantly reduced the risk of neonatal complications but showed no statistically significant effect on maternal complications.
followup_time: Up to the first 6 hours of the postpartum periods
gest_age: <28 weeks (at enrollment for first ANC visit)
